original.description: This tender covers stakeholder and user engagement, coordination, requirements consolidation, communication and capacity building relating to the development of Earth Observation (EO) services for climate change adaptation and disaster risk reduction in Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka. It is one of two tenders being implemented as part of the 'Support toDisaster Risk Reduction through Earth Observation and Climate Services in South Asia' (SADRR) initiative (2026-2029), which is being carried out in partnership with the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI), and funded by the Directorate-General for International Partnerships (DG INTPA) as part of the Global Gateway initiative.
